detail.title: Gripper apparatus
detail.abstract: Disclosed is a gripper apparatus. The gripper apparatus of the present invention includes: a body formed lengthily; a gripping member installed on a front surface of the body to grip an object; an opening and closing member mounted on an upper end of the gripping member to open and close the gripping member; and a pressurizing rod which can be introduced into or extracted from the opening and closing member so as to operate the opening and closing member, and is lengthily embedded in the body along the longitudinal direction of the pressurizing rod.
